products.descriptionHtml:
Ready for your home to become the best breakfast spot in town? With our 5-piece Breakfast Cookware Set, you’ll have all the tools you’ll need to create mouthwatering breakfasts. From stacks of fluffy pancakes and delectable French toast to piles of crisp bacon and scrumptious sausage, you’ll be able to cook it all to perfection without worry about running out of cookware. Our Breakfast Collection includes the 360 Cookware Square Griddle, 8.5" Fry Pan, 1 Quart Sauce Pan and the 360 Bakeware Jelly Roll Pan. So, you can count on even heat distribution, surgical-grade stainless steel, ergonomic, heat-resistant handles and a high level of durability.

The 2 Quart Saucepan gives you the space to handle everything from morning routines to weeknight dinners without pulling out a larger pot. It’s a versatile, easy-to-reach-for size that works hard in any kitchen.

The stainless steel cover gives you the flexibility to cook traditionally or use Vapor® Cooking to let the natural moisture in your food do more of the work.

Made in America from high-quality stainless steel with zero chemical nonstick coatings, it’s made to help you feel good about what you’re cooking with and what you put on the table.

Versatile enough for every day. Built to last for generations.

metafields.care:
{"en":"

For best results and to protect your cookware, we recommend hand washing your 360 Saucepan and Cover with warm water, mild dish soap and a soft sponge or cloth. Dry thoroughly after washing.

We do not recommend dishwasher use. Harsh dishwasher detergents can damage exposed aluminum within the cookware’s construction and may affect warranty coverage.

For stuck-on food, allow the pan to cool and soak it in warm, soapy water before cleaning. For tougher stains or discoloration, use 360 Cookware Cleaner. A mixture of vinegar and water can also help remove blue or rainbow discoloration.

","es":""}

The 4 Quart Stock Pot gives you plenty of room for soups, pasta, chili, one-pot meals and family-sized sides, while still being a practical size for everyday cooking. Its versatile size also makes it a great choice for many of the meals you’d traditionally make in a Dutch oven.

The stainless steel cover gives you the flexibility to cook traditionally or use Vapor® Cooking to let the natural moisture in your food do more of the work.

For even more versatility, the 4 Quart Stock Pot is compatible with the 360 Slow Cooker Base, sold separately, giving you the option for easy, hands-off slow cooking.

Made in America from high-quality stainless steel with zero chemical nonstick coatings, it’s made to help you feel good about what you’re cooking with and what you put on the table.

metafields.care:
{"en":"

For best results and to protect your cookware, we recommend hand washing your 360 Stock Pot and Cover with warm water, mild dish soap and a soft sponge or cloth. Dry thoroughly after washing.

We do not recommend dishwasher use. Harsh dishwasher detergents can damage exposed aluminum within the cookware’s construction and may affect warranty coverage.

For stuck-on food, allow the pot to cool and soak it in warm, soapy water before cleaning. For tougher stains or discoloration, use 360 Cookware Cleaner. A mixture of vinegar and water can also help remove blue or rainbow discoloration.

products.title: 360 Cookbook - Vapor Cooks Better!
products.descriptionHtml: Introducing 360 Cookware's "living" cookbook — Vapor® Cooks Better! Why do we call it a living cookbook? Because unlike traditional bound cookbooks, we made ours in a user-friendly binder format, so you can pull out a page to keep your recipe close by while you’re cooking. This design also allows you to easily add your own recipes to the book, creating a recipe archive for you and your family to treasure as a keepsake for years to come. Never lose a recipe again! Featuring renowned chefs like Akasha Richmon, Sophie Uliano and Colleen Covey, the Vapor® Cooks Better! This cookbook will introduce you to the basics of the Vapor® Cooking Method while also covering a variety of traditional recipe favorites. Learn all about the best ways to get the most out of your 360 Cookware and how to achieve peak freshness and flavor with the Vapor® cooking method that requires less cooking time and less heat.

products.title: Factory Second  360 Cookbook - Vapor Cooks Better!
products.descriptionHtml: Introducing 360 Cookware's "living" cookbook — Vapor® Cooks Better! Why do we call it a living cookbook? Because unlike traditional bound cookbooks, we made ours in a user-friendly binder format, so you can pull out a page to keep your recipe close by while you’re cooking. This design also allows you to easily add your own recipes to the book, creating a recipe archive for you and your family to treasure as a keepsake for years to come. Never lose a recipe again! Featuring renowned chefs like Akasha Richmon, Sophie Uliano and Colleen Covey, the Vapor® Cooks Better! This cookbook will introduce you to the basics of the Vapor® Cooking Method while also covering a variety of traditional recipe favorites. Learn all about the best ways to get the most out of your 360 Cookware and how to achieve peak freshness and flavor with the Vapor® cooking method that requires less cooking time and less heat.

products.descriptionHtml:
Smooth sides. More control. Made for stirring.

With its gently curved sides and wide cooking surface, the 2 Quart Saucier makes it easy to whisk, stir and reach every part of the pan. It’s a natural choice for sauces, risotto, custards, oatmeal, grains and anything that needs frequent stirring.

The rounded design helps ingredients move easily around the pan, while even heat distribution gives you better control over delicate recipes.

Made in America from high-quality stainless steel with zero chemical nonstick coatings, it’s made to help you cook with confidence and feel good about what you put on the table.

Better control. Easier stirring. Built to last for generations.

metafields.care:
{"en":"

For best results and to protect your cookware, we recommend hand washing your 360 Saucier with warm water, mild dish soap and a soft sponge or cloth. Dry thoroughly after washing.

We do not recommend dishwasher use. Harsh dishwasher detergents can damage exposed aluminum within the cookware’s construction and may affect warranty coverage.

For stuck-on food, allow the pan to cool and soak it in warm, soapy water before cleaning. For tougher stains or discoloration, use 360 Cookware Cleaner. A mixture of vinegar and water can also help remove blue or rainbow discoloration.

products.title: Apollo Popper by 360 Cookware
products.descriptionHtml:
Introducing the Apollo Popper by 360 Cookware, the ultimate kitchen tool for all popcorn lovers! This innovative and versatile popcorn popper has a unique design that allows for easy and simple popping of delicious popcorn anytime, anywhere. 

In a normal pan, the area the heat and oil reside in is the same area that the popped kernel sits in. Our concept was to use the kinetic energy of the popping kernel to move the corn out of the oil and into a "lifting zone." The unpopped kernels stay in the "popping zone." To test our theory, we machined 14 different mini designs testing each one on how well they performed. This proved our theory that a unique topography could create a better pan. From these variations, we refined what we believe is the ultimate design, the Apollo Popper by 360 Cookware. With its new design there is no need to shake the pan while cooking. Add all ingredients into pan and let the pan do the work for you. It should take about 3 minutes to finish popping, depending on the burner size you use. With the Apollo Popper you will have perfect popcorn on top of the stove in the same amount of time it would in a microwave… but without the harsh chemicals you find in those bags you use.

*Due to the design of the Apollo Popper, it may not work well on all induction stovetop variants. 

How to use your Apollo Popper by 360 Cookware:

  1. Choose a 1/4-, 1/3- or 1/2-size measuring cup depending on batch size.
  2. Fill the measuring cup with corn, but do not pour it into the pan yet.
  3. Add oil to the measuring cup until it fills the cup around the corn.
  4. Pour the corn and oil in the pan, and turn the stove on high.
  5. When the popping has slowed or stopped, remove the pan from the heat.
  6. Enjoy!

Note: Shaking the pan is not necessary. 

A Few Don'ts:

  1. Do not use the Apollo Popper in the microwave.
  2. Only grab from the handle when in use or warm.

Tips & Tricks:

  1. Once you pour your popcorn into the pan, it should take about 3 minutes to finish popping, depending on the burner you use.
  2. The shape of the inside of the pan-what resembles a dent in the middle-is the secret to perfect popcorn.
  3. The pan lid includes three indentations that vent the lid to avoid condensation on your popcorn.

It should take about 3 minutes to finish popping, depending on the burner size you use. With the Apollo Popper you will have perfect popcorn on top of the stove in the same amount of time it would in a microwave… but without the harsh chemicals you find in those bags you use.

How to use your Apollo Popper by 360 Cookware:

  1. Choose a 1/4-, 1/3- or 1/2-size measuring cup depending on batch size.
  2. Fill the measuring cup with corn, but do not pour it into the pan yet.
  3. Add oil to the measuring cup until it fills the cup around the corn.
  4. Pour the corn and oil in the pan, and turn the stove on high.
  5. When the popping has slowed or stopped, remove the pan from the heat.
  6. Enjoy!

Note: Shaking the pan is not necessary. 

A Few Don'ts:

  1. Do not use the Apollo Popper in the microwave.
  2. Only grab from the handle when in use or warm.

Tips & Tricks:

  1. Once you pour your popcorn into the pan, it should take about 3 minutes to finish popping, depending on the burner you use.
  2. The shape of the inside of the pan-what resembles a dent in the middle-is the secret to perfect popcorn.
  3. The pan lid includes three indentations that vent the lid to avoid condensation on your popcorn.

Classroom desserts, chocolate chip cookies for the whole team, holiday baking for the office cookie exchange – your cookie baking demands our large cookie sheet. Now you can make more cookies at one time thanks to our generously sized 17.5” x 14.22” stainless steel cookie sheet. But it’s not just the size that makes this cookie sheet so valuable. The true secret is in its special multi-layer design that conducts heat evenly and efficiently. That means every batch you bake will be cooked to perfection, from the cookies in the center of the sheet to those in the corners. No other bakeware cooks so evenly! Enjoy making dozens of little cookies or many monster cookies, you’ll have the flexibility to bake what you’d like. It’s especially nice for cooking up appetizers for dinner parties and family gatherings.

products.title: Cheese Spreader
products.descriptionHtml: Epicurean is a way of life-a reflection of our personal values and those of our customers. Every Epicurean cutting board and kitchen accessory is made with naturally renewable materials in an environmentally responsible way. Our products are well-designed, practical, casual tools that feel at home in any kitchen. Today, Epicurean cutting boards, kitchen tools and utensils are at the center of everyday life for both the casual cooks and seasoned gourmets. We pride ourselves on original designs that are simple, functional and beyond trend. Every Epicurean product is made in the U. S. A. , creating good jobs and strengthening the economy. Our cutting boards and tools get their Natural look and texture from our exclusive material called Richlite, a paper Composite which is non-porous, dishwasher safe, durable and easy on knives. It has been used in commercial kitchen and restaurants for over 75 years and meets the highest standards of cooks and chefs worldwide. We bet this will become the most used tool in your kitchen! The gracefully curved shape fits comfortably in your hand and the wide face with beveled edge lets you put more butter, jam or cheese down with less work. Cleanup is fast because, like all our other tools, this is dishwasher safe. The Natural spreader measures 8. 3" long.
